comment: Read from the maker's source at commit fd172d0, the installed 2.0.0. Every one of the sixty matrix buttons is a real LEDBezel parameter widget with its own position, so each is clickable and each has its own line; the lamp drawn over it is a light and is not clickable. Parameter index 0 is the C of octave -2 at the bottom of the left-hand column and index 59 is the B of octave 2 at the top of the right-hand column, so index order runs up each column and then across. The oct range and latch/toggle switches both name their positions in the order the code tests for, so neither is reversed. None of the seven inputs and neither output was given a name in the code. The p knob is configured with a per cent unit and no display multiplier, so its tooltip reads 0.5% where it means a probability of 0.5.
